Grado1.title: Grade 1
Grado1.description: ✅ What does the module include? Grade 1 – Building solid foundations with fun - Book 1: Basic operations (Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, and Division) and Smart Practice Problems for unlimited practice without altering the score. Colombian M.E.N. standards developed clearly and progressively. - Book 2: Projects, learning games, complementary activities, and a Saber Assessment Test. All books include exercises aligned with the Saber Assessment Test framework.
